decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - The extension [building] hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwelling known as No. 3 Brentwick Gardens.

Condition : 5 - The windows formed in the rear elevation of the proposal at first floor level shall be obscure glazed, hinged to open inwards and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.

Condition : 6 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the flank (northern and southeastern) and rear (eastern) walls of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 7 - The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 8 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8am to 6pm on Mondays to Friday and 8am to 1pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 9 - The garage or car parking accommodation shown on Amended Drawing No. 321-04-03 received 10 May 2005 shall be provided before the dwelling to which it relates is occupied and thereafter it shall not be used for any purpose other than the parking of vehicles.

Condition : 10 - The close-boarded timber fence to the rear of the site along the boundary with No. 5 Brentwick Gardens shall be retained at its existing height and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than to the same height.
description: Erection of a part two storey side extension, part two storey rear, and part single storey rear extension to existing house.
